dish: Tokachi butadon of thick-cut charcoal-grilled pork loin
n: Tokachi Butadon Ippin Honten (十勝豚丼 いっぴん本店)
w: A butadon house the locals rate with the founders — thick pork loin grilled and glazed in a sweet-soy tare over Tokachi rice.

dish: Indian curry — Obihiro's own curry chain (beef curry with house roux)
n: Curry Shop Indian Machinaka (カレーショップ インデアン まちなか店)
w: Tokachi's beloved curry counters, run by the Fujimori group — locals bring their own pots for take-out; this is the downtown branch.

dish: Ryūgetsu 'Sanporoku' birch-log baumkuchen at the factory
n: Ryūgetsu Sweetpia Garden, Otofuke (柳月スイートピア・ガーデン)
address: Natsuzora 1-1, Otofuke, Katō District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Tokachi confectioner Ryūgetsu's factory park — watch the production line, then the cake shop and café.
